Headline: Gameday Men’s Health Alaska - Managing Director
Bio: I was in my mid-thirties, sitting on the couch on a sunny July afternoon with nowhere to be and no desire to move. Seemingly perfect day, but couldn't tell you why I felt nothing. I knew something was off. I looked around for a clinic that could help and came up empty. So I spent months researching, piecing together my own solution, and eventually got to a place where I felt like myself again. A couple years later I had a newborn son. And somewhere in those early sleepless months I started thinking about what I actually wanted to model for him, what I wanted him to see when he watched his dad move through the world. I wasn't living up to that yet. Those two moments are why Gameday Men's Health Anchorage exists. I spent sixteen years in commercial banking before opening the clinic in May 2025. The finance background helps, but the reason I'm here is simpler than that: I looked for this place, couldn't find it, and decided to build it. We do TRT, peptides, medical weight loss and ED treatments. In person, cash-pay, in a space that doesn't feel like a waiting room. A second location in the Mat-Su Valley is in progress. If you're an employer, a clinician, or someone building something in Alaska, I'm always open to a conversation.
